initialChecksVersionNote: Historical actual interactions only, excluded from final acceptance. They preceded the UI-only source-count/source-wording refinement and included a forced click. The final protocol requires a visible real browser, ordinary clicks and no skipped assertions.

finalPage.visibility: visible before all ordinary mouse/keyboard action groups and at completion
finalPage.scope: A fresh worker-owned file page after the explicit S007-to-S031 handoff. No shared-page navigation. Explicitly released directly to S005 afterward.
finalPage.reasonForFreshPage: The earlier prepared page could not establish ordinary click actionability under shared foreground contention.

finalExecution.method: Compact inlined equivalent of the owned real-Playwright-Page protocol, using the tool's actual page object.
finalExecution.note: The tool has no CommonJS require loader. The protocol was therefore inlined rather than claiming that Node or require executed browser tests. The CJS file is a reusable replay protocol; five Node syntax checks include it, but the Node unit suite does not execute it.
finalExecution.countingNote: Includes visibility guards and environment checks. Six case counts total 123; six outer visibility/environment checks complete 129.
